question: Whom did Brahmā pacify by speaking?
premises: The verse says he spoke pacifying.
It names Vasiṣṭha, best of sages, as son.
inference: Brahmā spoke pacifying to Vasiṣṭha, best of sages.
uncertainties: The speaker is implied as Brahmā.
plain_english: He said, pacifying his son Vasiṣṭha, best of sages.
